---
title: "Sensitivity Analysis: Distal Minority Stress"
author: "XXXX"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

This file tests distal minority stress (discrimination) in two ways (Supplementary Material S4):

* as a monthly predictor of the stress and distress deviations, in the same way as the identity development experiences (Tables S3a and S3b)
* as a baseline covariate added to the final model (Table S12)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(MplusAutomation)

# Set WD
set.seed(123)
setwd("C:XXXX")

# Import data
GZMCore <- readRDS("C:XXXX")

# Fit indices reported in the tables
fit_cols <- c("Title", "Parameters", "ChiSqM_Value", "ChiSqM_DF", "ChiSqM_PValue",
              "CFI", "RMSEA_Estimate", "RMSEA_90CI_LB", "RMSEA_90CI_UB", "SRMR", "AIC", "BIC")
```

# Mplus Data

`d` = distal stress (discrimination) at W0 to W4.

```{r mplus data}
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Proximal minority stress composite (x) and distress (y), W0 to W4
    x1 = StressComp_W0, x2 = StressComp_W1, x3 = StressComp_W2, x4 = StressComp_W3, x5 = StressComp_W4,
    y1 = DASS_Total_W0, y2 = DASS_Total_W1, y3 = DASS_Total_W2, y4 = DASS_Total_W3, y5 = DASS_Total_W4,

    # Gender: 0 = cisgender, 1 = trans or gender diverse
    gender = case_when(GenderGroup %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0, GenderGroup %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1),

    # Ethnoracial identity: 0 = White, 1 = People of Colour
    race = case_when(RaceAnalysis == 1 ~ 0, RaceAnalysis == 2 ~ 1),

    # Age and baseline (lifetime) identity experience count, centred on the sample mean
    Age0    = Age - mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0 = msbase - mean(msbase, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Baseline distress group: 0 = at or below the median, 1 = above the median
    dgrp = case_when(y1 <= median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0, y1 > median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1)
  )

GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    d1 = EISS_A_W0, d2 = EISS_A_W1, d3 = EISS_A_W2, d4 = EISS_A_W3, d5 = EISS_A_W4,

    # Baseline distal stress, centred on the sample mean (used as a covariate)
    dbase0 = EISS_A_W0 - mean(EISS_A_W0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

mplus_z <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5,
         y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_z[is.na(mplus_z)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_z, "modelz.dat")
```

# Distal Stress Growth Shape (Table S3a)

```{r distal stress growth models}
# Intercept only
mplusSyntaxG1Disc <- ("
TITLE: G1Disc Intercept-only growth model - Distal Stress;

DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  idisc | d1@0 d2@0 d3@0 d4@0 d5@0;
  [idisc];
  idisc;
  [d1-d5@0];

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG1Disc, "modelg1disc.inp")

# Fixed linear slope
mplusSyntaxG2Disc <- ("
TITLE: G2Disc Fixed linear slope growth model - Distal Stress;

DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  idisc sdisc | d1@0 d2@1 d3@2 d4@3 d5@4;
  [idisc sdisc];
  idisc;
  sdisc@0;
  [d1-d5@0];

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG2Disc, "modelg2disc.inp")

# Random linear slope
mplusSyntaxG3Disc <- ("
TITLE: G3Disc Random linear slope growth model - Distal Stress;

DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  idisc sdisc | d1@0 d2@1 d3@2 d4@3 d5@4;
  [idisc sdisc];
  idisc;
  sdisc;
  idisc WITH sdisc;
  [d1-d5@0];

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG3Disc, "modelg3disc.inp")

# Freed time scores (retained)
mplusSyntaxG4Disc <- ("
TITLE: G4Disc Freed time scores growth model - Distal Stress;

DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Freed time scores - intermediate loadings estimated freely
  ! d1 fixed at 0, d5 fixed at 1 for identification
  idisc sdisc | d1@0 d2* d3* d4* d5@1;
  [idisc sdisc];
  idisc sdisc;
  idisc WITH sdisc;
  [d1-d5@0];

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxG4Disc, "modelg4disc.inp")
```

```{r run distal stress growth models}
runModels("modelg1disc.inp")
runModels("modelg2disc.inp")
runModels("modelg3disc.inp")
runModels("modelg4disc.inp")
```

```{r table s3a}
table_s3a <- bind_rows(
  readModels("modelg1disc.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modelg2disc.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modelg3disc.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modelg4disc.out", what = "summaries")$summaries
) %>%
  select(any_of(fit_cols))

table_s3a
write.csv(table_s3a, "TableS3a_distal_growth_fit.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Slope mean, slope variance and intercept-slope covariance (reported in S4)
g4disc <- readModels("modelg4disc.out", what = "parameters")$parameters
filter(g4disc$unstandardized, param %in% c("IDISC", "SDISC"))
filter(g4disc$stdyx.standardized, paramHeader == "IDISC.WITH")
```

# Distal Stress as a Monthly Predictor (Table S3b)

```{r distal stress monthly models}
# Same-month effects
mplusSyntaxDisc_con <- ("
TITLE: DISC_CON Discrimination as contemporaneous time-varying predictor;
DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5 x1-x5 y1-y5 dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Discrimination as contemporaneous time-varying predictor
  ! Equality constrained across waves
  rx1 ON d1 (disc_x_con);
  rx2 ON d2 (disc_x_con);
  rx3 ON d3 (disc_x_con);
  rx4 ON d4 (disc_x_con);
  rx5 ON d5 (disc_x_con);

  ry1 ON d1 (disc_y_con);
  ry2 ON d2 (disc_y_con);
  ry3 ON d3 (disc_y_con);
  ry4 ON d4 (disc_y_con);
  ry5 ON d5 (disc_y_con);

  ! Discrimination endogenous means and variances
  [d1-d5];
  d1-d5;

  ! Covariates
  ix ON dgrp;
  sx ON dgrp;
  iy ON dgrp;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxDisc_con, "modeldisc_con.inp")

# Next-month effects
mplusSyntaxDisc_lag <- ("
TITLE: DISC_LAG Discrimination as lagged time-varying predictor;
DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5 x1-x5 y1-y5 dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Discrimination lagged effects
  ! Discrimination at wave t predicting residuals at wave t+1
  rx2 ON d1 (disc_x_lag);
  rx3 ON d2 (disc_x_lag);
  rx4 ON d3 (disc_x_lag);
  rx5 ON d4 (disc_x_lag);

  ry2 ON d1 (disc_y_lag);
  ry3 ON d2 (disc_y_lag);
  ry4 ON d3 (disc_y_lag);
  ry5 ON d4 (disc_y_lag);

  [d1-d5];
  d1-d5;

  ix ON dgrp;
  sx ON dgrp;
  iy ON dgrp;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxDisc_lag, "modeldisc_lag.inp")

# Same-month and next-month effects
mplusSyntaxDisc_both <- ("
TITLE: DISC_BOTH Discrimination contemporaneous and lagged;
DATA:
  FILE = modelz.dat;
VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = d1-d5 x1-x5 y1-y5 dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);
ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;
MODEL:
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous effects
  rx1 ON d1 (disc_x_con);
  rx2 ON d2 (disc_x_con);
  rx3 ON d3 (disc_x_con);
  rx4 ON d4 (disc_x_con);
  rx5 ON d5 (disc_x_con);

  ry1 ON d1 (disc_y_con);
  ry2 ON d2 (disc_y_con);
  ry3 ON d3 (disc_y_con);
  ry4 ON d4 (disc_y_con);
  ry5 ON d5 (disc_y_con);

  ! Lagged effects
  rx2 ON d1 (disc_x_lag);
  rx3 ON d2 (disc_x_lag);
  rx4 ON d3 (disc_x_lag);
  rx5 ON d4 (disc_x_lag);

  ry2 ON d1 (disc_y_lag);
  ry3 ON d2 (disc_y_lag);
  ry4 ON d3 (disc_y_lag);
  ry5 ON d4 (disc_y_lag);

  [d1-d5];
  d1-d5;

  ix ON dgrp;
  sx ON dgrp;
  iy ON dgrp;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxDisc_both, "modeldisc_both.inp")

runModels("modeldisc_con.inp")
runModels("modeldisc_lag.inp")
runModels("modeldisc_both.inp")
```

```{r table s3b}
table_s3b <- bind_rows(
  readModels("modeldisc_con.out",  what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modeldisc_lag.out",  what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modeldisc_both.out", what = "summaries")$summaries
) %>%
  select(any_of(fit_cols))

table_s3b
write.csv(table_s3b, "TableS3b_distal_monthly_fit.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Distal Stress as a Baseline Covariate (Table S12)

```{r covariate data}
mplus_z_cov <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5,
         y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp, dbase0)
mplus_z_cov[is.na(mplus_z_cov)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_z_cov, "modelz_cov.dat")
```

```{r covariate model}
mplusSyntaxdist_cond <- ("
TITLE: Final conditional LCM-SR - SIDEs contemporaneous + all covariates 
  + distal stress as a covariate;

DATA:
  FILE = modelz_cov.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 d1-d5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender 
    race dgrp dbase0;
  USEVARIABLES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender 
    race dgrp dbase0;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - freely estimated
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous SIDE effects - equality constrained across waves
  rx2 ON m2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON m3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON m4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON m5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON m2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON m3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON m4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON m5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting growth factors
  ! dbase0 added as between-person distal stress covariate
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0 dbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0 dbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0 dbase0;

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting milestone exposure
  m2-m5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0 dbase0;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxdist_cond, "modeldist_cond.inp")
runModels("modeldist_cond.inp")
```

```{r table s12}
distal <- readModels("modeldist_cond.out", what = c("summaries", "parameters"))
select(distal$summaries, any_of(fit_cols))

table_s12 <- distal$parameters$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(distal$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s12, "TableS12_distal_covariate.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Key results: identity experience effects, between-person covariances and distal stress effects
filter(table_s12, param %in% c("M2", "M3", "M4", "M5"))
filter(table_s12, paramHeader %in% c("IX.WITH", "SX.WITH"))
filter(table_s12, param == "DBASE0")
```
